abstract: # EquiGraspFlow: SE(3)-Equivariant 6-DoF Grasp Pose Generative Flows The official repository for (Byeongdo Lim, Jongmin Kim, Jihwan Kim, Yonghyeon Lee, and Frank C. Park, CoRL 2024) - [Project page](https://equigraspflow.github.io/) - [Openreview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=5lSkn5v4LK&referrer=%5BAuthor%20Console%5D(%2Fgroup%3Fid%3Drobot-learning.org%2FCoRL%2F2024%2FConference%2FAuthors%23your-submissions)) - [Paper](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=5lSkn5v4LK) - [Video](https://youtu.be/fxOveMwugo4?si=L1bmYNOMPbCHY1Cr) - [Poster](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UTBoNDDT7FzHcXHSrFDA6x4v5hr3-g51/view?usp=sharing) ## Requirements ### Conda environment You can create a Conda environment using the following command. You can customize the environment name by modifying the `name` field in the `environment.yml` file. This will automatically install the required packages, including: - `python==3.10` - `omegaconf` - `tensorboardX` - `pyyaml` - `numpy==1.26` - `torch` - `scipy` - `tqdm` - `h5py` - `open3d==0.16.0` - `roma` - `pandas` - `openypyxl` To activate the environment, use: ### Dataset We use the Laptop, Mug, Bowl, and Pencil categories of the ACRONYM dataset [1]. The dataset can be downloaded from [this link](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1H1PeUbyxvNtzoWc6Le2pKqOqp2WLSnau?usp=drive_link). Create a `dataset` directory and place the data in that directory, or customize the path to the dataset by modifying `DATASET_DIR` in `acronym.py` and `utils.py` within the `loaders` directory. ## Training ### Train a new model The training script is `train.py`, and comes with the following arguments: - `--config`: Path to the training configuration YAML file. - `--device`: GPU number to use (default: `0`). Use `cpu` to run on CPU. - `--logdir`: Directory where the results will be saved (default: `train_results`). - `--run`: Name for the training session (default: `{date}-{time}`). abstract_zh: 本文提出了EquiGraspFlow，一种基于SE(3)-等变归一化流的6自由度抓取姿态生成模型。该模型利用等变扩散过程在SE(3)流形上生成抓取姿态，确保对物体点云的旋转和平移具有等变性。在ACRONYM数据集上的实验表明，EquiGraspFlow在抓取成功率上优于现有方法，同时保持了生成姿态的多样性和物理可行性。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出EquiGraspFlow，一种SE(3)-等变的6-DoF抓取姿态生成流模型，在部分点云条件下通过归一化流生成与物体位姿等变的抓取姿态分布。


# 一、动机

> 现有6-DoF抓取姿态生成方法对物体位姿变化泛化不足，缺少对SE(3)变换的对称性建模，导致在真实场景中面对任意物体姿态时性能受限。


# 二、方法

> 提出EquiGraspFlow，一种SE(3)-等变的6-DoF抓取姿态生成流模型，在部分点云条件下通过归一化流生成与物体位姿等变的抓取姿态分布。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文在ACRONYM数据集的Laptop、Mug、Bowl、Pencil类别上评估，但摘要中未给出具体数字，需查阅原始论文获取成功率/提升幅值。


# 四、对我的启发

> SE(3)等变性是提升抓取姿态泛化的重要手段；该生成流框架可扩展到其他机器人操作任务，但需关注点云部分遮挡和训练复杂度。与课题直接相关。
